Akali.escape: Don’t engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down; check whether Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution are also available. In particular, when your Fury is high and before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up, close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If the fight will require Tryndamere R Undying Rage, decide on an escape route first.
Akali.build: Build magic resistance first against Akali’s main damage. Also build health to prepare for the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution.
Akali.combo: Start an all-in with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, then build Fury with basic attacks. If Akali turns her back while fleeing, look to apply the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it expires.
Akali.fight: Build Fury, then fight back when Akali emerges from Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack.
Akali.laning: If Akali hides in Akali W Twilight Shroud, don’t chase recklessly. Build a health and CS lead during windows when Akali R Perfect Execution is unavailable. Even when quickly clearing the lane, check river vision first if you plan to use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage.
Akali.phase: If your team lacks teamfight damage late, push a side lane and pressure a turret.
Akali.teamfight: After the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control is used on your frontline, flank to target the ranged damage dealer. After taking focused fire, activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die and attack the carry. Against Akali, check whether Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip are still available before engaging.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, the second dash will follow even if you try to escape, so after being hit, don’t rely on Tryndamere E Spinning Slash alone to get away; prepare for the follow-up. Akali R Perfect Execution’s second hit deals more damage based on your missing health, so activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die.

Chogath.phase: Early on, Tryndamere’s trades are weak without Fury, but it’s better to pressure Cho’Gath before he builds stacks. Cho’Gath gets stronger over time and becomes harder to deal with, so later, push a side lane as the situation allows to draw enemy forces.
Chogath.build: After completing one core damage item, if Cho’Gath builds armor and your basic attacks become ineffective, get armor penetration early with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik’s Regards. Build magic resistance against the damage from Cho’Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. Cho’Gath R Feast deals true damage, so resistances can’t block it.
Chogath.combo: Check your Fury before engaging. If Cho’Gath Q Rupture marks the ground, dodge to the side or escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. After Cho’Gath W Feral Scream is down, lead with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and keep basic attacking. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it expires.
Chogath.escape: The moment after Cho’Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave or spends W Feral Scream is a chance to engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Cho’Gath has no mobility spell, so he has trouble creating distance once you get on him, but check your Fury and escape route before engaging. After using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, keep basic attacking to create another chance to use it to escape.
Chogath.fight: Build Fury, dodge Cho’Gath Q Rupture, and fight when Cho’Gath W Feral Scream is down. Reduce his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and keep basic attacking. If Cho’Gath turns his back and starts to flee, look to apply the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Chogath.laning: Early on, build Fury by attacking minions and pressure Cho’Gath to limit his chance to scale comfortably. Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces minions, so don’t stand in a straight line behind them. Look to engage right after Cho’Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave. When he can’t stay in lane, push the wave and pressure his turret.
Chogath.teamfight: In teamfights, flank to target the enemy ranged damage dealer instead of fighting Cho’Gath for long. Engage as soon as immobilizing crowd control such as Cho’Gath Q Rupture is used on your frontline. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused fire kills you and attack the carry while it lasts.
Chogath.watch: Cho’Gath Q Rupture marks the ground before knocking you airborne, so dodge to the side when you see the marker. If silenced by Cho’Gath W Feral Scream, you can’t escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, so avoid facing him directly. Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces minions and deals damage based on your max health, so step out of the line when Cho’Gath basic attacks. When low on health, watch the range of Cho’Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.

Camille.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, W Tactical Sweep, and E Hookshot. Resistances can’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about choosing an item that only adds a lot of health. Basic attacks and attack speed are also key parts of her damage, so consider effects that reduce attack speed.
Camille.fight: Build Fury, then choose a moment to fight that avoids the time just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield activates. Look to chase when Camille has used E Hookshot to engage and can’t use R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Camille.combo: Build Fury, then reduce Camille’s attack damage first with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with E Spinning Slash. Build Fury with basic attacks and reduce E Spinning Slash’s cooldown with critical strikes. If Camille turns her back to flee, look to apply the slow from W Mocking Shout. Use R Undying Rage just before you die, then heal with Q Bloodlust when needed to survive.
Camille.escape: After Camille E Hookshot is down, check whether R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available before engaging. It’s a good time to close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash when she can’t use either mobility option.
Camille.laning: Stand away from walls and among minions to limit Camille E Hookshot’s engage angles. Build Fury by attacking minions, then trade after the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses is gone. Camille clears the wave slowly before her first core item, so take control of the lane during this window and use Tryndamere’s resource-free E Spinning Slash and basic attacks to clear the wave and pressure her turret.
Camille.phase: Early on, look to control the lane and pressure Camille’s farming before she gets her first core item, but Tryndamere’s trades are weak without Fury. Camille can take down turrets quickly in a side lane from midgame onward, so don’t leave a side lane open. If your team lacks teamfight damage late, apply pressure by split pushing.
Camille.teamfight: After immobilizing crowd control such as Camille E Hookshot is used on your frontline, flank to target the enemy ranged damage dealer. Don’t use Tryndamere R Undying Rage early; save it for just before focused fire kills you. Before an objective, if R Undying Rage is ready, consider pushing the opposite side lane to draw enemies away.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses a wall to engage and stun, so stand away from walls and dodge when you see the hook attach. If trapped by Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, it’s difficult to get out, so dodge Camille W Tactical Sweep or E Hookshot before engaging. If trapped, wait out the zone’s duration.

Aurora.teamfight: Flank to target the enemy ranged damage dealer instead of fighting the frontline for long. If Aurora uses her leap to engage and gets no takedown, that’s a chance to close in. If an ally is taken down, Aurora W Across the Veil may reset, so don’t leave low-health allies behind. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused fire kills you, then secure your target or escape before it expires.
Aurora.build: Build magic resistance against Aurora’s main damage.
Aurora.combo: When you have enough Fury, lead with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and keep basic attacking. If Aurora turns her back to flee, look to apply the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. Use critical strikes from basic attacks to reduce Tryndamere E Spinning Slash’s cooldown, so you can close in again after Aurora’s leap or escape.
Aurora.escape: The window to engage is when Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down. If you need Tryndamere R Undying Rage, decide on an escape route first so you can leave before it expires.
Aurora.fight: Build Fury and check river vision, then fight when Aurora is within Tryndamere E Spinning Slash range. If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, wait for her brief stealth to end and for her to reappear. If health has decreased and the recall damage from Aurora Q Twofold Hex would hit, disengage from the trade.
Aurora.laning: Early on, take health losses while farming against ranged Aurora until you get a chance to close the gap. Build Fury by attacking minions, and push the wave to pressure a turret when Aurora cannot stay in lane. Don’t use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage without river vision.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Tryndamere’s trades are weak without Fury, so farm through Aurora’s ranged harass. If your team lacks teamfight damage late, push a side lane to draw out players from Aurora’s team.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and that damage increases with your missing health. If cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora; if your health is low, retreat before the recall. After Aurora R Between Worlds creates its zone, you are slowed when leaving it, so decide whether to leave before the zone appears or fight inside it.

Garen.combo: When Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack is down and you have enough Fury, reduce his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Build Fury with basic attacks, but don’t commit all your attacks the moment Garen W Courage activates. When Garen turns to run, look to slow him with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape or Tryndamere Q Bloodlust to heal.
Garen.build: Build armor first to deal with the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. However, Garen E Judgment reduces armor and Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so don’t rely on armor alone to survive. If Garen builds armor and your basic attacks stop dealing much damage, finish one core item, then get penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards.
Garen.escape: Engage after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack has been fully spent and you’ve confirmed river vision. Garen has no mobility ability, so if you have enough Fury, you can close the distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Keep using basic attacks after engaging to reduce the cooldown on Tryndamere E Spinning Slash in case you need to disengage.
Garen.fight: Build Fury and trade briefly immediately after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack has been used on a minion or fully spent. Don’t stay close and fight for long while Garen E Judgment is spinning; move out of its range. Don’t commit all your attacks the moment Garen W Courage activates; wait a beat.
Garen.laning: Early on, hit minions to build Fury with Tryndamere P Battle Fury, then apply pressure. Push the wave and hit the turret when Garen can’t stay in lane, giving him less room to build stacks on Garen W Courage. Before using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, check river vision to guard against a gank.
Garen.phase: Early on, Tryndamere’s trades are weak without Fury, so build Fury to pressure Garen. Garen becomes harder to deal with as he gains stacks on Garen W Courage, so slow his scaling from the start. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, push a side lane.
Garen.teamfight: In teamfights, don’t stay on the frontline; flank from the side or behind and target the ranged damage dealers. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline, and activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks kill you. Around an objective, if Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready, consider pushing the opposite side lane to draw enemies away.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his basic attack and silences, so don’t approach first while he has it available. When Garen E Judgment starts, move outside its spin range so you don’t take hits for long. Garen R Demacian Justice becomes more dangerous as your health gets lower, so don’t stay near Garen at health low enough to be executed.

Malphite.laning: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, but don’t stay within range of Q Seismic Shard long enough to lose health. Clear waves and pressure the turret when Malphite cannot stay in lane.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. If Malphite builds armor and your basic attacks become ineffective, finish one core item, then accelerate your armor penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik’s Regards.
Malphite.combo: Check that you have enough Fury, break Malphite P Granite Shield, then lower his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with E Spinning Slash. Keep basic attacking to build Fury, and look to slow Malphite with W Mocking Shout when he turns to run. Activate R Undying Rage just before you would die, then either escape with E Spinning Slash or heal with Q Bloodlust to keep fighting.
Malphite.escape: Once Malphite E Ground Slam is also down, you can basic attack without worrying about its attack speed reduction.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then build Fury before trading. Don’t force an engage right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits or while E Ground Slam is available. Once Malphite E Ground Slam is down, lower his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close the gap with E Spinning Slash.
Malphite.phase: If your team lacks teamfight damage late, push a side lane to draw enemy forces away.
Malphite.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock up several of you at once, then counterattack right after R is down. Tryndamere should flank to reach the enemy ranged damage dealers instead of spending a long time fighting Malphite on the frontline. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline, and activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks would kill you.
Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, its slow makes it hard to engage or disengage, so don’t start a trade right afterward. Malphite E Ground Slam reduces your attack speed and therefore your basic attack damage output, so engage after it is down. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t be interrupted while he dashes, so watch for an engage from bushes or behind walls when he’s out of sight, and keep your distance from allies.

Urgot.watch: Urgot E Disdain is a dash with a stun and shield, so be careful not to take it head-on. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, you are heavily slowed and become a target for Urgot W Purge, so use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash when you need to get away. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get out of Urgot's range before your health reaches the execute threshold.
Urgot.build: Build armor first against Urgot's main damage. If Urgot builds armor and your basic attacks start dealing less damage, complete one core item, then bring forward your armor penetration purchase with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Urgot.combo: With Fury built, once Urgot E Disdain is down, use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce his attack damage and engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Keep attacking to build Fury, and if Urgot turns to run, look for the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout if it is available. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then decide whether to escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or keep fighting while healing with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it ends.
Urgot.escape: Right after making Urgot use his only mobility ability, Urgot E Disdain, is your chance to go in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Check your Fury and river vision before engaging. If you need to escape after being hit by Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to get away.
Urgot.fight: Build Fury, then look to fight while Urgot E Disdain is down. Use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce his attack damage, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and keep attacking. If you cannot finish the fight, get completely out of Urgot's short range, since Urgot P Echoing Flames damage builds up the longer you stay near him.
Urgot.laning: Early on, focus on collecting CS and building Fury, even if it costs you health, rather than trying to beat Urgot head-on. Check river vision, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash when Urgot E Disdain is down. Clear the wave and pressure the turret while the enemy cannot stay in lane.
Urgot.phase: Early on, Tryndamere's trades are weak when he has no Fury, and as a melee champion it is hard to face Urgot head-on. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, apply pressure with a split push and avoid dangerous side lanes while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is down.
Urgot.teamfight: Do not fight the frontline for long; flank to target the ranged carry. Engage the moment Urgot E Disdain is used on your frontline, and cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused fire. If side lane pressure is more valuable than joining the teamfight, push the side opposite an objective to draw enemy forces away.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Gwen’s magic damage, and consider armor to withstand her basic attacks. Gwen has relatively high armor, so add armor penetration to support Tryndamere’s physical damage. You can’t block the true damage at the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with resistances, so dodge it with your positioning.
Gwen.combo: Build Fury, reduce Gwen’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and follow up with basic attacks. Only look to slow Gwen with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout once she turns to run. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape or Tryndamere Q Bloodlust to heal and keep fighting before it ends.
Gwen.escape: Engaging just after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down lets you exploit the window when her mobility ability is unavailable. If you use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, make sure you have enough Fury and keep using basic attacks so Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is ready for your escape. Gwen R Needlework can slow you, so choose an escape route before using Tryndamere R Undying Rage.
Gwen.fight: Just after Gwen uses Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is your chance to close the distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Build Fury first, reduce her attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in and follow up with basic attacks. Move to the side to avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, enter it or wait for it to end.
Gwen.laning: Early on, hit minions to build Fury, then trade before Gwen can stack Q. If Gwen has fully stacked it, interrupt healing from outside basic attack range and don’t force your way in. Check river vision, then cross the wave with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage. Pressure the wave and turret when Gwen can’t stay in lane.
Gwen.phase: Early on, Tryndamere’s trades are weak when he’s out of Fury, but you have a chance to fight before Gwen stacks Q. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, pressure turrets with a split push.
Gwen.teamfight: Instead of fighting Gwen on the frontline for long, flank from the side or behind and target the enemy ranged damage dealers. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline, and activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks kill you. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready, you can also push the opposite side lane around an objective to draw enemies away.
Gwen.watch: The center of the cone from Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals heavy true damage, so move to the side when she casts it. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target Gwen from outside the mist, and her armor increases, so enter it or wait for it to end. Also watch out for the slow and maximum-health-based damage from Gwen R Needlework during extended fights.

Sion.laning: Early on, your trades are weak when Battle Fury is empty, so build Fury before fighting, then clear the wave with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and basic attacks. Disrupt Sion’s farming and pressure the turret while he can’t stay in lane. Check river vision when using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage.
Sion.build: If Sion builds armor and your basic attacks deal less damage, complete one core item, then get armor penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards. If you need defenses, build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Prioritize avoiding Sion E Roar of the Slayer, which reduces your armor.
Sion.combo: Build Fury, then use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce Sion's attack damage and Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to close in. Follow up with basic attacks to build Fury, and use the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout when Sion turns to run. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, but first plan a route to escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash within its duration.
Sion.escape: Engaging after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash's charge or making him use it early lets you avoid its knock-up and stun. After using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, keep landing basic attacks to create an opportunity to use it to escape.
Sion.fight: Hit minions before trading to build Tryndamere P Battle Fury, and engage after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash's charge or making him use it early. When Sion W Soul Furnace activates, focus your damage to break its shield before it bursts. Rather than using Tryndamere Q Bloodlust as soon as health drops, save it until you need it to survive and make use of its attack damage bonus.
Sion.phase: Early on, Tryndamere's trades are weak without Battle Fury, so build Fury before fighting. Sion's maximum health increases as he farms CS, so do not let him farm freely until late game. If your team lacks teamfight damage, push a side lane to gain an advantage.
Sion.teamfight: Instead of fighting Sion head-on for a long time, flank to target the enemy ranged carry. Engage after immobilizing crowd control such as Sion Q Decimating Smash has been used on your frontline, and cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused fire. At an objective, if your ultimate is ready, you can also push the opposite side lane to draw enemy forces away.
Sion.watch: Sidestep Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught instead of fleeing forward or backward, and avoid meeting it in narrow paths. After taking Sion down, reposition to avoid the fast attacks and percent-max-health damage from Sion P Glory in Death.

Aatrox.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and W Infernal Chains. If the duel goes on, consider Grievous Wounds after armor. Aatrox also has high armor, so add penetration when building damage.
Aatrox.combo: Build Fury, then lead with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Keep basic attacking while dodging the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade to reduce Tryndamere E Spinning Slash’s cooldown. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then secure an escape route or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust to continue fighting.
Aatrox.escape: Right after Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, look to close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, leave the area immediately before it pulls you in. Consider before engaging that you may need Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape. While Aatrox R World Ender is active, create distance and re-engage after it ends.
Aatrox.fight: Early on, look to trade right after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. Build Tryndamere P Battle Fury, then reduce his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If you see Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, dodge the blade’s edge and keep basic attacking. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, stop fighting and back off.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, avoid giving up kills and focus on CS. Build Fury by attacking minions before a fight or using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash through the wave. When Aatrox cannot stay in lane, clear the wave and pressure his turret, but check river vision before using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage.
Aatrox.phase: Early on, Tryndamere has low critical strike chance and Aatrox can snowball a lead easily, so avoid giving up kills and focus on CS. If your team lacks teamfight damage late, push a side lane and pressure a turret.
Aatrox.teamfight: After crowd control such as Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade or W Infernal Chains is used on your frontline, flank to target the enemy ranged damage dealer. After engaging and taking focused fire, activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die and attack the carry. When pushing a side lane to draw enemies out, check that Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is dangerous if it hits with the blade’s edge, so watch the cast animation and move out of range or close in. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave the area immediately, using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape if needed. Aatrox R World Ender increases his healing, so create distance and wait out its duration.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius’s main damage, but keep in mind that armor alone won’t stop the penetration on Darius E Apprehend or the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. If Darius’s armor makes your basic attacks ineffective, finish one core item, then get penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik’s Regards.
Darius.combo: When Darius E Apprehend is down, reduce his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, and secure a way to escape afterward or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend has been used without hitting or is on cooldown. Check your Fury and escape route before engaging. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash.
Darius.fight: Build Fury for critical strike chance, then fight during the brief window when Darius E Apprehend is down. The moment after Darius Q Decimate is used to clear minions is also a chance to trade. Avoid extended fights that build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks; create distance to drop the stacks, then engage again.
Darius.laning: Early on, don’t force trades while your Fury is empty. Focus on CS and build Fury. Save Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to respond to Darius E Apprehend, and only close in deeply after checking river vision. When Darius cannot stay in lane, clear the wave and pressure his turret.
Darius.phase: Early on, Tryndamere’s trades are weak without Fury, while Darius is strong in early skirmishes, so don’t overcommit. If your team lacks teamfight damage late, pressure a turret from a side lane.
Darius.teamfight: Don’t fight the frontline for long; flank to target the enemy ranged damage dealer. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control is used on your frontline, and cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused fire kills you. When pushing a side lane to draw enemy forces, check that Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with basic attacks, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so wait outside its range. If you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the axe’s outer edge or hug him to reduce its damage and healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance to drop them. When low on health, watch out for the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If the duel drags on and Dr. Mundo’s healing becomes a problem, build resistance first, then get Grievous Wounds. If Dr. Mundo builds armor and your basic attacks become ineffective, finish one core item, then get armor penetration early with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik’s Regards.
DrMundo.combo: Build Fury, reduce Dr. Mundo’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and keep using basic attacks. If Dr. Mundo turns his back to flee, use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to slow him if it’s available. Use Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it ends.
DrMundo.escape: Dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash when your Fury is high. Dr. Mundo has no skill to create distance himself, but if Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available, look for an opening after it has been used instead of forcing a kill. If using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, check river vision and decide on an escape route.
DrMundo.fight: Build Fury, reduce Dr. Mundo’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Dr. Mundo has no skill to create distance himself, so keep basic attacking once you’re on him and use critical strikes to reduce Tryndamere E Spinning Slash’s cooldown. Don’t immediately use Tryndamere Q Bloodlust merely because health has decreased; heal when needed for survival.
DrMundo.laning: Build Fury by attacking minions before trading, and dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw from behind minions. Step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops as you retreat after a trade to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction. Push the wave and pressure his turret while Dr. Mundo can’t stay in lane.
DrMundo.phase: Early on, Tryndamere’s trades are weak when his critical strike chance is low, so maintain the lane while building Fury. If your team lacks teamfight damage late, apply pressure in a side lane, but don’t push deep when Tryndamere R Undying Rage is unavailable.
DrMundo.teamfight: Flank to target the enemy ranged damage dealer instead of fighting Dr. Mundo at the front for long. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control is used on your frontline, and cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused fire kills you. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available and a kill would take too long, consider pressuring a side lane to draw enemy forces out.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target and deals more damage when your current health is high, so dodge with minions between you and him. Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper deals area damage and heals him. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, his healing and movement speed increase, so don’t focus on killing him during that time.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework.
Fiora.combo: Build Fury and confirm Fiora Q Lunge and W Riposte are down. Reduce her attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and keep using basic attacks. If Fiora turns her back to flee, look to apply the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. If you’re in danger, activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die.
Fiora.escape: The moment after Fiora Q Lunge is down is an opening to close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If Fiora W Riposte is still available, it can block your attack and retaliate, so bait it out before engaging. Check your Fury and escape route before engaging.
Fiora.fight: Build Fury, then look for an opening when Fiora Q Lunge is down. If Fiora W Riposte is available, she can negate your attack, so bait it out first. Reduce her attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Once on her, build Fury with basic attacks and use Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die.
Fiora.laning: Stand opposite an exposed vital and look to counterattack when Fiora moves in with Q Lunge. After a short trade, don’t chase recklessly; maintain Fury by attacking minions and focus on CS. When Fiora can’t stay in lane, push the wave and pressure her turret.
Fiora.phase: Early on, Tryndamere’s trades are weak when his Fury is empty, so build Fury first.
Fiora.teamfight: If hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, hug a wall to prevent her from hitting all four vitals. In teamfights, flank to target the enemy ranged damage dealer instead of fighting the frontline for long. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control is used on your frontline, and activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused fire kills you.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and retaliates, so don’t rush in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash while it’s available. When Fiora lunges toward a vital with Q Lunge, stand on the opposite side of the vital to narrow her angle. If hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, hug a wall to block one side of the vitals.

Gangplank.build: Build armor first in lane to deal with the poke from Gangplank Q Parrrley and the physical damage from Gangplank E Powder Keg. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage deal true damage that resistances can’t block, so build health too. If the fight drags on and the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy becomes a problem, consider Executioner's Calling.
Gangplank.combo: Just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, reduce his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Follow up with basic attacks and land critical strikes to bring Tryndamere E Spinning Slash back sooner. When Gangplank turns to run, look to slow him with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape or Tryndamere Q Bloodlust to heal before it ends.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage just after he places Gangplank E Powder Keg, when there are no ripe kegs nearby. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is available, he can remove crowd control, so look for a slow with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout after it’s down. Before going in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, check your Fury and river vision.
Gangplank.fight: Build Fury, then trade just after Gangplank E Powder Keg has been placed, while it’s still unprimed. Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so reduce his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Once close, build Fury with basic attacks and land critical strikes to bring Tryndamere E Spinning Slash back sooner.
Gangplank.laning: When you’re out of Fury, avoid forcing a fight. Hit minions to build Fury and secure CS. Back off if Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, and look for a fight just after he places one. Before using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, check river vision. Push the wave to pressure the turret when Gangplank can’t stay in lane.
Gangplank.phase: Early on, Tryndamere has no critical strike chance when he’s out of Fury, making trades weak, so focus on CS and building Fury.
Gangplank.teamfight: Instead of fighting the frontline head-on, flank from the side or behind and target the ranged damage dealers. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline, and activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks kill you. Around an objective, if Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready, you can also push the opposite side lane to draw enemies away.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg slows, and the riper the keg, the more dangerous it is, so back away if a ripe keg is nearby. Destroy kegs yourself from outside the blast radius, and don’t step where two kegs overlap. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage deal true damage, so when low on health, don’t cross a large area alone where Cannon Barrage could land.

Gnar.build: Build armor first to deal with the main sources of Gnar’s damage: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, Gnar E Hop / Crunch, and Gnar R GNAR!. If Gnar builds armor and your basic attacks stop dealing much damage, finish one core item, then get armor penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards.
Gnar.combo: Before fighting, hit minions to build Tryndamere P Battle Fury, then engage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout followed by Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Once close, keep using basic attacks to land critical strikes and reduce the cooldown on Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Use Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust or escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash before it ends.
Gnar.escape: Just after Mini Gnar Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down is your chance to close the distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Don’t engage while Gnar is transforming into Mega Gnar; wait it out, then look for an all-in after he returns to Mini Gnar, while he can’t transform again. If you use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, plan your escape route in advance.
Gnar.fight: Build Fury, then when Mini Gnar Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout first and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. When fighting face-to-face, look to reduce his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout; slow him when he turns to run. Avoid fighting head-on and create distance just after he transforms into Mega Gnar.
Gnar.laning: While taking poke from Mini Gnar, wait until he’s within range of Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and secure CS. Move out of the path of Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss as it travels out and back. If you can prevent Gnar from catching the boomerang, there will be a longer gap before his next poke. Check river vision, then close in while Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down. Clear the wave to pressure the turret when Gnar can’t stay in lane.
Gnar.phase: Early on, watch out for Mini Gnar’s ranged poke while building Tryndamere P Battle Fury to create opportunities to fight. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, pressure the side lane and turret.
Gnar.teamfight: Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! can stun you against a wall, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain. Just after Gnar returns from Mega to Mini, use the window when he can’t transform again to start a fight with your team. Tryndamere should flank from the side or behind and target the ranged damage dealers, then use Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks kill him.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows, so move out of the boomerang’s path as it travels out and back. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals damage based on your maximum health, so stacking health alone won’t be enough to withstand it. Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so avoid positions with your back to one.

Illaoi.build: Build armor first to deal with the physical damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Account for Illaoi’s healing by getting Executioner's Calling for Grievous Wounds before looking for an opportunity to kill her. If Illaoi builds armor and your basic attacks stop dealing much damage, finish one core item, then get Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards earlier.
Illaoi.combo: Check your Fury, reduce Illaoi’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Keep using basic attacks to land critical strikes and reduce the cooldown on Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. When Illaoi turns to run, look to slow her with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape or Tryndamere Q Bloodlust to heal before it ends.
Illaoi.escape: Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is her only mobility ability, so just after she uses it is your chance to close the distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. You have a better opening if you’ve also dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Before engaging, check your Fury and river vision, and plan a Tryndamere E Spinning Slash route to escape.
Illaoi.fight: With Fury built, fight after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit or once Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down. Reduce her attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and follow up with basic attacks. If your spirit has been pulled but you’re in a position to fight, counterattack instead of only running away.
Illaoi.laning: Hit minions to build Fury, but don’t let the wave stay near a wall where tentacles can attack. Last hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range, and if it hits you, first decide whether you can fight. If you choose not to fight, break the tether, dodge the first tentacle, then wait near it until the mark ends.
Illaoi.phase: Early on, Tryndamere’s trades are weak without Fury because he has no critical strike chance, so build Fury while focusing on CS and holding your lane. However, avoid fighting near Illaoi’s tentacles regardless of the difference in items. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, make up for it by pressuring a side lane.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t group up in front of Illaoi R Leap of Faith; spread out and wait out its duration. If you can’t destroy the tentacles, draw Illaoi into open ground away from walls. Tryndamere should flank from the side or behind and target the ranged damage dealers, then activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks kill him.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so make a particular effort to dodge it when going for a last hit near a wall. Don’t fight near tentacles created by Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God while taking hits from Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash and Illaoi R Leap of Faith; back off into open ground. When Illaoi R Leap of Faith activates, create distance briefly to wait out its peak damage window.

Irelia.combo: When Irelia Q Bladesurge is down and you have enough Fury, use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout first, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Once close, keep using basic attacks to build Fury. When Irelia turns to run, look to slow her with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. Use Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it ends.
Irelia.escape: Immediately after forcing Irelia to use Q Bladesurge is your chance to close the distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, it’s a good time to engage. Before going in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, check river vision to guard against a gank.
Irelia.fight: Build Fury, then fight the moment Irelia Q Bladesurge is down. First reduce Irelia’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and follow up with basic attacks. If you don’t have enough Fury, don’t use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage.
Irelia.laning: Early on, hit minions to build Fury, but don’t leave low-health minions between you and Irelia. Clear the wave and pressure the turret when Irelia can’t stay in lane.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a big impact in teamfights, so focus Irelia first. After the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline, flank from the side or behind to reach the ranged damage dealers. Use Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks kill you.
Irelia.watch: Irelia can repeatedly close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge by dashing to low-health minions. Create distance when minions are about to die, and watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: Jax’s damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so prioritize ways to reduce his attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking a lot of health alone.
Jax.combo: Once you confirm Jax E Counter Strike is down, lower his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Then build Fury with basic attacks and use critical strikes to reduce the cooldown of Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. When Jax turns to run, look to slow him with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is a chance to close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If you engage after Jax E Counter Strike is also down, you can attack without being stunned. If Jax E Counter Strike is still available, save Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape its stun range.
Jax.fight: After building Fury, lower Jax’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash while Jax E Counter Strike is down. Don’t basic attack while Jax E Counter Strike is active; move out of its stun range. Check your Fury before engaging so critical strikes can reduce the cooldown of Tryndamere E Spinning Slash.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee trade, so don’t force an engage. Clear waves and pressure the turret when Jax cannot stay in lane.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t group around him; wait for the area stun to end. Tryndamere should flank to reach the enemy ranged damage dealers after their immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks would kill you, and find an escape route with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash before it ends.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move out of its stun range. Its recast damage increases with each attack it dodges, so save Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to disengage until its duration ends.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first to deal with Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance won’t block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone.
Jayce.combo: Build Fury, reduce Jayce’s attack damage first with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Follow up with basic attacks to build Fury and land critical strikes to reduce the cooldown on Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. When Jayce turns to run, look to slow him with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Jayce.escape: Just after Jayce uses the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! in hammer form is your chance to close the distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. It’s a good time to fight if Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is also down. Before engaging, check your Fury and river vision, and make sure you can keep using basic attacks until Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is ready again.
Jayce.fight: Build Fury to gain critical strike chance, and fight after Jayce’s leap and knockback are down. Reduce his attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and follow up with basic attacks. Even after health has decreased, if you can survive, delay the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust to take advantage of the attack damage increase.
Jayce.laning: Early on, don’t force trades against Jayce’s ranged poke; move side to side and secure CS. Wait to engage until Jayce is in range of Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, then check river vision before closing in. Clear the wave and pressure the turret when Jayce can’t stay in lane.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so farm defensively and wait it out. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, pressure a turret in a side lane.
Jayce.teamfight: Instead of fighting the frontline, flank from the side or behind and target Jayce. Engage when the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the immobilizing crowd control are down. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks kill you, then finish the fight or use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and Tryndamere Q Bloodlust to escape before it ends.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce is holding his cannon, move sideways out of the line as soon as Jayce E Acceleration Gate is placed to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast. When he’s holding his hammer, watch out for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Kayle.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Kayle’s damage, but first dodge the direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which reduces your resistance if it hits.
Kayle.combo: After building Fury, lower Kayle’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and keep basic attacking. If Kayle turns to run, Tryndamere W Mocking Shout can also slow her. Attack again after the invulnerability from Kayle R Divine Judgment ends, and activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you would die to keep fighting or escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility spell, so the window after you dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast and she uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing is a good time to close in. Check river vision and your Fury, then engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Don’t go too deep if you have no escape route or Tryndamere R Undying Rage is unavailable.
Kayle.fight: After dodging Kayle Q Radiant Blast or after Kayle uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing, lower her attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If you use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash only to engage while your Fury is low, it will be hard to disengage, so check your Fury before going in.
Kayle.laning: Clear waves while building Fury, and pressure the turret when Kayle cannot stay in lane.
Kayle.teamfight: Don’t spend time on the frontline; flank or approach from outside vision to reach Kayle. Move in when your allies can apply crowd control to her, and wait for the invulnerability from Kayle R Divine Judgment to end. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks would kill you, then target Kayle.
Kayle.watch: If Kayle Q Radiant Blast hits you, it slows you and reduces your armor, so dodge the direct hit before closing in. When your health is low, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade, which deals damage based on your missing health, and activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you would die. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, hold your damage and attack again after her invulnerability ends.

Kled.build: Kled’s main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting is physical, so build armor first. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking a lot of health alone.
Kled.combo: Build Fury, lower Kled’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and basic attack. Use the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout when Kled turns to run. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you would die, then escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it ends.
Kled.escape: Don’t engage just because Kled E Jousting is down; check whether Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is still available. The window before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back up is especially good for closing the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash before it pulls you in.
Kled.fight: After building Fury, lower Kled’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If you’re about to take all four attacks from Kled W Violent Tendencies, back off briefly. If you can finish dismounted Kled before his Courage fills, press the attack; if not, back off and prevent him from building the Courage needed to remount.
Kled.laning: Early on, avoid trading when your Fury is empty; hit minions to build Fury before fighting. Use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash carefully when engaging so you can escape if Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you. If you dismount Kled, push him out of lane so he can’t build Courage on minions or the turret.
Kled.phase: Early on, Tryndamere’s trades are weak with no Fury, so don’t give Kled an advantage. Kled weakens after the laning phase and mid game, so use Tryndamere’s split push late when the situation allows.
Kled.teamfight: Maintain vision on the flanks so you can see Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! coming from a distance. If you can’t stop it, keep your frontline positioned to take the first hit along its path, and don’t break formation. Tryndamere should flank to reach the enemy ranged damage dealers after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks would kill you.
Kled.watch: If Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, watch out for the maximum-health damage on his fourth basic attack. Back off before taking all four hits, then close in again. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash before it pulls you in.

Nasus.build: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike deals primarily physical damage, so build armor first. If Nasus builds armor and your basic attacks become ineffective, finish one core item, then accelerate your armor penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik’s Regards.
Nasus.combo: After checking that you have enough Fury, lower attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Keep basic attacking to use critical strikes to reduce the cooldown of Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Use Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you would die, then use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape or Tryndamere Q Bloodlust to heal if you’re continuing the fight.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no way to create distance other than Flash, so after Nasus W Wither is down, you have a chance to close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, keep your distance until it ends. If you used Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, keep basic attacking to regain a way to disengage.
Nasus.fight: Lower Nasus’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and keep basic attacking. Don’t force a fight if Nasus W Wither slows you or Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: Let the lane come toward you so Nasus can’t comfortably stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike under his turret. Maintain Fury and pressure him while he goes for last hits; when Nasus cannot stay in lane, clear the wave and hit the turret. Check river vision before engaging with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash.
Nasus.phase: You become more disadvantaged over time because of Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks, so make up for it late with side lane pressure when the situation allows.
Nasus.teamfight: Don’t face Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance. If you join a teamfight, flank to reach the enemy ranged damage dealers instead of hitting the frontline. Use Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks would kill you. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available, you can also push the side lane opposite the objective to draw enemy forces away.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither lowers both movement speed and attack speed, making it dangerous for Tryndamere, who relies on basic attacks. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so move out of the area. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting him head-on and wait out its duration.

Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor can’t block, so build up your total health as well. If Olaf builds armor and your basic attacks become ineffective, finish one core item, then accelerate your armor penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik’s Regards.
Olaf.combo: After building Fury, lower Olaf’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and approach with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Once close, build Fury with basic attacks and use critical strikes to reduce the cooldown of Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Look to slow Olaf with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout when he turns to run. Use Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you would die, then escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before its duration ends.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so once you have enough Fury and have prevented him from retrieving the axe from Olaf Q Undertow, you have a chance to close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Movement impairments don’t work during Olaf R Ragnarok, so don’t rely on the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to engage. Create distance and wait out its duration; before using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, check river vision and your escape route.
Olaf.fight: When you have enough Fury, lower Olaf’s attack damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and basic attack. Keep in mind that Olaf gets stronger at low health, so don’t chase him to the end just because he is at half health. Save Tryndamere R Undying Rage until just before you would die, and plan an escape route when you use it.
Olaf.laning: Early on, avoid weak trades when your Fury is empty; hit minions to build Fury before looking for a melee fight. Move opposite the direction Olaf Q Undertow lands to prevent him from retrieving the axe. Focus on maintaining your lane rather than rushing for a kill, and push waves to pressure the turret when Olaf cannot stay in lane.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so avoid giving him a kill and buy time while farming Fury and CS. If your team lacks teamfight damage late, push a side lane and pressure the turret.
Olaf.teamfight: In teamfights, flank to reach the enemy ranged damage dealers instead of staying on the frontline. After going in, activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before focused attacks would kill you, then attack the damage dealers. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available, you can also push the side lane opposite the objective at objective time to draw the enemy away.
Olaf.watch: If Olaf Q Undertow hits you, it reduces your armor and slows you, so move in the opposite direction from where the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. Don’t force a fight while the shield and attack speed increase from Olaf W Tough It Out are active. Even at low health, Olaf P Berserker Rage gives him increased attack speed and healing, and armor can’t reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing.

Ornn.build: Even if you build critical strike items, if Ornn’s armor weakens your basic attacks, complete one core item, then get Last Whisper or Lord Dominik’s Regards earlier for armor penetration. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so do not build only one type of resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about investing heavily in health alone.
Ornn.combo: After building Fury, reduce Ornn’s Attack Damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and keep up your basic attacks. Do not use Tryndamere Q Bloodlust immediately just because health has decreased; heal when survival is necessary or before your Fury runs out. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then secure an escape route with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or keep fighting while healing with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust during its duration.
Ornn.escape: Do not force an engage when only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, since Ornn can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Look to close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash when both mobility spells are down or before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up. Before engaging, check river vision and your Fury, then keep basic attacking once you are on him so Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is available again.
Ornn.fight: Start a fight when you have enough Fury, and if Ornn W Bellows Breath applies Brittle to you, back off until the effect ends. When Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are down, use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce his Attack Damage, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Once you are on him, build Fury with basic attacks and look to slow him with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout when he turns to flee.
Ornn.laning: Early on, build Fury by attacking minions before trading with Ornn. Avoid walls and the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, and move in to disrupt Ornn if he tries to craft an item in lane. While Ornn cannot stay in lane, clear the wave with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and basic attacks, then pressure the turret.
Ornn.phase: Ornn’s damage is low early, but Tryndamere also trades poorly without Fury, so build Fury to take lane control. If your team lacks teamfight damage in the late game, push the side lane to draw enemies away and apply pressure before Ornn’s items and his allies’ Masterwork upgrades stack up.
Ornn.teamfight: Circle around to the side or behind to target the enemy ranged carry instead of fighting Ornn head-on. Engage when Ornn’s immobilizing crowd control is used on your frontline, and avoid the straight line along which the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God travels back and forth. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused attacks and attack the carry. If your ultimate is ready, you can also push the side lane opposite the objective to draw enemies away.
Ornn.watch: The pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture creates a collision point for Ornn E Searing Charge, so stand in open space away from the pillar and walls. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, you are vulnerable to bonus damage and long crowd control, so keep your distance until the effect ends. Account for the spirit’s return on Ornn R Call of the Forge God and move out of the line between the spirit and Ornn.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first to withstand Pantheon’s main ability damage. However, Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone. Pantheon has relatively high armor, so mix in penetration to boost Tryndamere’s physical damage.
Pantheon.combo: When Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and you have enough Fury, start with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Keep basic attacking to reduce Tryndamere E Spinning Slash’s cooldown with critical strikes. When Pantheon turns to flee, look to slow him with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die.
Pantheon.escape: When Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, look for a chance to close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Check whether Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available, since he can use it to escape. After using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, keep basic attacking to reduce its cooldown, and choose an escape route before casting Tryndamere R Undying Rage.
Pantheon.fight: Build Fury and engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. Use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce his Attack Damage, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and keep up your basic attacks. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait to attack from the front or circle around to the side.
Pantheon.laning: When Pantheon Q Comet Spear pokes you, keep minions between you and him while farming. Build Fury before fighting, and push the wave to pressure the turret when Pantheon cannot stay in lane.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off in the late game, so Tryndamere can gain an advantage through side lane pressure when his team lacks teamfight damage.
Pantheon.teamfight: When immobilizing crowd control such as Pantheon W Shield Vault is used on your frontline, circle around from the side or behind to target the enemy ranged carry. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused attacks, then attack or escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash during its duration. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so check whether it is available before entering its range. When Pantheon Q Comet Spear pokes you, keep minions between you and him. When he uses Pantheon E Aegis Assault, stop attacking from the front or circle around to the side.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper’s Verdict. Keep in mind that Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on maximum health when deciding whether to invest heavily in health alone. If Poppy builds armor and your basic attacks become ineffective, complete one core item, then get Last Whisper or Lord Dominik’s Regards for armor penetration.
Poppy.combo: Make sure Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Reduce her Attack Damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and build Fury with basic attacks. Use critical strikes to reduce Tryndamere E Spinning Slash’s cooldown while securing an escape route. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape or restore your health with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust during its duration.
Poppy.escape: Right after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is a chance to close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. However, if Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait before dashing in, and engage in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge cannot knock you into a wall.
Poppy.fight: Build Fury and fight when Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended. Reduce her Attack Damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and keep up your basic attacks. Use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to slow Poppy when she turns to flee. Even if Poppy’s health has decreased, her armor may increase further, so calculate your finishing damage before chasing.
Poppy.laning: Early on, trades are weak when your Fury is empty, so attack minions to build Fury before fighting Poppy. Do not stand with your back to a wall, and leave the area from Poppy Q Hammer Shock immediately. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first to prevent her from gaining the shield. When there is no opening to fight, focus on farming and staying in lane, and pressure the turret when Poppy cannot stay in lane.
Poppy.phase: Early on, Tryndamere trades poorly without Fury, so build Fury while holding the lane. If your team lacks teamfight damage in the late game, push the side lane to pressure the turret. Consider the risk of being caught in a side lane when Tryndamere R Undying Rage is down.
Poppy.teamfight: Circle around to the side or behind to target the enemy ranged carry instead of fighting Poppy, the frontline, for too long. Look for an opening when Poppy’s immobilizing crowd control is used on your frontline. After coming under focused attacks, cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then eliminate the carry or escape during its duration.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, a dash with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash will be blocked and you will be unable to use movement abilities briefly, so wait for it to end or walk in. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so stay in open space. If you are hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before the second strike. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move to the side from in front of her.

Quinn.build: The starting purchase cannot be determined from the available information alone. Build armor to withstand Quinn’s damage; do not prioritize magic resistance.
Quinn.combo: Build Tryndamere P Battle Fury, use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout first, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash while Quinn E Vault is down. Keep landing basic attacks to reduce Tryndamere E Spinning Slash’s cooldown with critical strikes. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust or escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash during its duration.
Quinn.escape: The moment Quinn E Vault goes down is your window to engage. Close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash then, but delay the engage if you lack river vision or do not have enough Fury.
Quinn.fight: Trade when Quinn E Vault is down and you have built up enough Tryndamere P Battle Fury. Reduce Quinn’s Attack Damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and keep up your basic attacks. Look to slow Quinn with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout when she turns to flee.
Quinn.laning: Early on, farm and preserve your health outside Quinn’s range, and farm while Quinn P Harrier’s mark is gone. Stand behind minions to avoid Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and only close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash after checking river vision. After Quinn learns Tryndamere R Undying Rage, watch for her roams. If you lose track of her, maintain vision of the side lanes and jungle paths.
Quinn.phase: Quinn has a range advantage early, so Tryndamere should focus on farming and preserving his health. If your team lacks teamfight damage in the late game, gain an advantage through side lane and turret pressure.
Quinn.teamfight: Circle around to the side or behind to target the enemy ranged carry instead of fighting the frontline head-on. If Quinn comes in from the side, respond by slowing her with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and engaging with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused attacks. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready, you can also push the opposite side lane to draw enemies away.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of range before she lands an empowered basic attack. Stand behind minions against Quinn Q Blinding Assault so that a minion is the first target hit. Quinn E Vault knocks Tryndamere back and moves Quinn away, so do not force your way in before it is down.

Renekton.build: Build armor first to withstand Renekton’s main damage. However, armor does not block the damage from Renekton R Dominus, and empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces armor, so positioning to avoid that dash is important. If Renekton builds armor and your basic attacks become ineffective, complete one core item, then get Last Whisper or Lord Dominik’s Regards earlier.
Renekton.combo: Build Tryndamere P Battle Fury, reduce Renekton’s Attack Damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and keep up your basic attacks. Look to slow Renekton with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout when he turns to flee. If you cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or restore your health with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it ends.
Renekton.escape: The moment after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice is a chance to close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. It is especially good to engage if Renekton used his dash to disengage and has also spent the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Delay the engage if you do not have enough Fury or do not think Tryndamere E Spinning Slash will be available again for your escape.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton has no Fury or just after he has used Q, W, and E. Before engaging, build up enough Tryndamere P Battle Fury, reduce Renekton’s Attack Damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If you survive Renekton’s first combo, counterattack with basic attacks, and cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die.
Renekton.laning: Early on, prioritize farming and staying in lane without giving Renekton a kill. Before fighting, build Tryndamere P Battle Fury by attacking minions, but do not stand in or behind a minion wave that Renekton E Slice and Dice can use to engage. Push the wave and pressure the turret when Renekton cannot stay in lane.
Renekton.phase: In the late game, push the side lane to pressure the turret if your team lacks teamfight damage.
Renekton.teamfight: If you join a teamfight, approach the enemy ranged carry from the side or behind instead of fighting the frontline. Go in after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control is used on your frontline, and cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused attacks. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready, you can also push the side lane opposite the objective to draw enemies away.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton’s Fury is above half or close to it, stay out of range to avoid the empowered stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice grants a second dash if it hits a unit, so do not stand in or behind a minion wave.

Riven.build: Riven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven starts getting ahead, buy defensive items earlier, and also build health to account for Riven R Blade of the Exile’s damage based on your missing health.
Riven.combo: Build Fury, reduce her Attack Damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Keep landing basic attacks to build critical strikes and Fury, and look to slow Riven with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout when she turns to flee. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust during its duration.
Riven.escape: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are both mobility abilities, so do not engage just because one is down. In particular, close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash during the window when Riven W Ki Burst and her third Q have been used, before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up.
Riven.fight: Build Fury and look for a chance to fight when Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. Reduce her Attack Damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and keep up your basic attacks. Use critical strikes to reduce Tryndamere E Spinning Slash’s cooldown so you have a way out.
Riven.laning: Before fighting, build Fury by attacking minions, and avoid forcing trades when your Fury is empty. Look to counterattack when Riven Q Broken Wings is used on the wave, but check river vision before engaging with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Focus on holding the lane rather than fixating on a kill, and pressure the wave and turret while Riven is away.
Riven.phase: Early on, Tryndamere trades poorly without Fury, so build Fury and look for a window when Riven Q Broken Wings is down. In the late game, push the side lane to draw enemies away if your team lacks teamfight damage.
Riven.teamfight: Watch for Riven’s third Q Broken Wings or W Ki Burst to be used on your frontline, then approach the enemy ranged carry from the side or behind. Do not cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage before engaging; use it just before you die under focused attacks. If R is ready, you can also push the side lane opposite the objective to draw enemies away.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings closes the gap with three dashes and a knock-up, so back away when you see the first dash. You can still cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage even if you are stunned by Riven W Ki Burst. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her Attack Damage and range increase, and its damage based on missing health is also dangerous, so create distance until its duration ends.

Rumble.build: If you need a defensive item, choose one with magic resistance first. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone. Also account for Rumble E Electro Harpoon reducing your magic resistance when it hits.
Rumble.combo: Build Fury, briefly wait out the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield, then engage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and basic attacks in that order. Use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to slow Rumble if he turns to flee.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility abilities, so the moment after he uses Rumble W Scrap Shield and its shield disappears is a chance to close in. If you are hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, do not force the engage; create distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash before the second harpoon arrives. If you need to use Tryndamere R Undying Rage, first choose a route that lets you escape during its duration.
Rumble.fight: Build Fury and look for an opening when the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield disappears. Use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout first, close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, and keep up your basic attacks. Avoid trades where you take Rumble Q Flamespitter for too long, and fight when Rumble has to walk forward.
Rumble.laning: Early on, focus on farming instead of forcing trades while your Fury is empty. Before fighting, build Fury by attacking minions, check river vision, then engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Clear the wave and pressure the turret when Rumble cannot stay in lane.
Rumble.phase: Early on, Tryndamere trades poorly without Fury, so hold the lane while avoiding prolonged exposure to Rumble Q Flamespitter. If your team lacks teamfight damage in the late game, gain value through side lane pressure.
Rumble.teamfight: Do not fight the frontline for too long; circle around to the side or behind to target the enemy ranged carry. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control is used on your frontline, and cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused attacks. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available, you can also push the side lane opposite the objective to draw enemies away.
Rumble.watch: Watch out for the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon. If you are hit by both shots, the slow becomes much stronger and your magic resistance is reduced, so immediately create distance after the first hit or escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Avoid staying near Rumble for long to reduce the damage from Rumble Q Flamespitter.

Sett.build: Build armor first to withstand damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Armor cannot reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so avoid the center of its targeting line.
