If Sett builds armor and your basic attacks stop dealing much damage, complete one offensive item, then get armor penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards.
Sett.combo: Make sure you have enough Fury, cast Tryndamere W Mocking Shout first, then engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Once on him, build Fury with basic attacks and reduce Tryndamere E Spinning Slash's cooldown with critical strikes. When Sett W Haymaker is empowered, avoid its center and back off. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die.
Sett.escape: When Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper is down, you have an opening to go in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If you used Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, check whether critical strikes can make it available again and plan your escape route.
Sett.fight: Build Fury, then use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce Sett's attack damage and Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to close in. Right after focusing damage on Sett, back off to watch for Sett W Haymaker, then go back in once his grit has cooled down. Chase Sett with the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout when he turns to run.
Sett.laning: Build Fury by hitting minions before trading, and do not stand across from the minion group with Sett between you and the minions, to avoid the stun from Sett E Facebreaker. You can quickly build Fury and engage by using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash through the minion wave. Push the wave and pressure the turret when Sett cannot stay in lane.
Sett.phase: Early on, Tryndamere's trades are weak when he has no Fury, so build Fury before fighting. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, gain an advantage by pressuring a side lane.
Sett.teamfight: After immobilizing crowd control such as Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper has been used on your frontline, flank to target the ranged carry. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused fire, then kill the carry or escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash before it ends. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready, you can also push the side lane opposite an objective to draw the enemy out.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker gets stronger after he takes damage, so briefly back off after dealing heavy damage and avoid the center of its targeting line when it activates. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if enemies are on both sides of Sett, so do not stand across from the minion group with Sett between you and the minions. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it grabs you, so be careful when engaging while it is available.

Shen.build: Build critical strike items, but if Shen builds armor and your basic attack damage drops, complete one core item, then get Last Whisper or Lord Dominik’s Regards earlier. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so do not build only one type of resistance. Since the duration of his taunt is dangerous, consider Tenacity before stacking more resistance.
Shen.combo: Build Fury before fighting. After Shen E Shadow Dash misses, engage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, then Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Resume basic attacking once Shen W Spirit’s Refuge ends, and if Shen turns to flee while Tryndamere W Mocking Shout is still available, look to slow him. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, and use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or Tryndamere Q Bloodlust according to your escape route.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is a chance to close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Shen can also escape with Shen R Stand United, so do not chase far just because Shen E Shadow Dash is down; look for an opening before Shen R Stand United comes back up. Before engaging with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, check that you have enough Fury and an escape route.
Shen.fight: Build Tryndamere P Battle Fury by attacking minions, then start a fight. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, reduce his Attack Damage with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. While Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, keep your distance instead of basic attacking and wait for it to end.
Shen.laning: Early on, do not force trades while your Fury is empty; focus on farming. After building Fury, take lane control when Shen E Shadow Dash is down, and push the wave to keep Shen occupied farming. If Shen leaves lane with Shen R Stand United, alert your team and take advantage of the empty lane and turret.
Shen.phase: Early on, Tryndamere trades poorly without Fury, but Shen is weak in lane, so build Fury and look to take control.
Shen.teamfight: Shen can join fights elsewhere with Shen R Stand United, so alert your team if Shen disappears or starts channeling. If you join a teamfight, target the enemy ranged carry from the side or behind instead of the frontline, and engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control is used on your frontline. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused attacks.
Shen.watch: If you are taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you are likely to take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so avoid the dash path. Also move out of the path of Shen’s spirit blade as it returns to him. When Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is placed, stop basic attacking and resume once it ends.

Singed.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Singed's damage, and get movement speed to escape his poison trail. If the enemy builds armor and your basic attacks start dealing little damage, build Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards earlier, after completing one core item.
Singed.combo: Build Fury, cast Tryndamere W Mocking Shout first, then use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash along a route clear of adhesive to close in. Once on him, keep landing basic attacks and look to apply W's slow when Singed turns to run. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, but plan a route to escape with E before it ends and consider when to heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust.
Singed.escape: Engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash when Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down and a route clear of adhesive opens up. Singed has no skill that creates distance on his own, so this is a chance to get on him, but account for adhesive and poison trails along your escape route before going in.
Singed.fight: Build Fury by hitting minions before trading. Use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash along a route not covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive to close in, then keep landing basic attacks to create a chance for your E to come back up for your escape. If Singed runs while leaving poison behind, stop chasing unless you have enough damage to finish him for certain.
Singed.laning: Instead of chasing through Singed Q Poison Trail for a long time, clear the wave with E and basic attacks, then pressure the turret when Singed cannot stay in lane. Check river vision before using E to engage.
Singed.phase: If your team lacks teamfight damage later, pressure turrets with a split push, but do not overstay in a side lane while R is down.
Singed.teamfight: Do not chase Singed all the way through his poison. While your allies lock him down, flank to target the enemy ranged carry. Engage after the enemy's immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline, and cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused fire.
Singed.watch: Do not chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash cannot be used on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and getting hit by Singed E Fling there also roots you, so go around areas covered by the adhesive. If Singed has his back to your allies, Singed E Fling can throw you into the enemy team, so watch your engage position.

Skarner.build: If Skarner R Impale's suppression is a problem, first decide whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build. Build magic resistance first to withstand damage, considering Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. If Skarner builds armor and your basic attacks deal little damage, build Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards earlier after one core item.
Skarner.combo: Build Fury, and once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, cast Tryndamere W Mocking Shout first, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Keep landing basic attacks to reduce Tryndamere E Spinning Slash's cooldown with critical strikes, and look for the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout when Skarner turns to run. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it ends.
Skarner.escape: Right after making Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, you have an opportunity to go in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. However, if Skarner R Impale is still available, you cannot escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash while suppressed, so plan your escape route first. If you are about to die while grabbed, endure it with Tryndamere R Undying Rage, which can be cast during crowd control.
Skarner.fight: Build Fury, then look to fight while Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down. Use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce his attack damage, then close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and keep landing basic attacks. Unless you are at risk of dying, do not rush to use Tryndamere Q Bloodlust; make use of the attack damage bonus based on your missing health.
Skarner.laning: Before trading, build Fury by hitting minions or using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash through the wave. When positioned with your back to a wall, avoid Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, and engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash only after checking river vision. Push the wave and pressure the turret while Skarner cannot stay in lane.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Tryndamere's trades are weak when he has no Fury, so build Fury before fighting. Look for early lane priority and objectives so Skarner does not have time to build tank items. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, push a side lane.
Skarner.teamfight: After immobilizing crowd control such as Skarner E Ixtal's Impact has been used on your frontline, flank to target the ranged carry. Skarner R Impale ignores terrain and drags you along, so do not stand close to the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready, turn it on just before you die under focused fire; if it is down, do not overextend while split pushing.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns when it slams you into a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. The more you are hit at close range by Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval's empowered basic attacks, the more dangerous they are, so keep your distance. If Skarner R Impale suppresses you, Tryndamere E Spinning Slash cannot free you, so position yourself to avoid being dragged toward your allies.

Teemo.build: Teemo Q Blinding Dart, E Toxic Shot, and R Noxious Trap deal mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Also prepare Oracle Lens to clear traps around objectives and in narrow paths.
Teemo.combo: Build Fury, and once Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, cast Tryndamere W Mocking Shout first, then close in with E Spinning Slash. Once on him, build Fury with basic attacks and look for the slow from W when Teemo turns to run. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape or heal with Q Bloodlust before it ends.
Teemo.escape: Teemo has no dedicated dash, but Teemo W Move Quick makes him faster, so engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Check river vision and your Fury before going in, and plan a route for E to use when escaping.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Build Fury and check river vision beforehand, then close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash before Teemo W Move Quick lets him get away. If you decide to go in, avoid a short trade where you only take a poisoned basic attack before backing off.
Teemo.laning: Early on, wait for an opening outside Teemo's range and collect CS. Avoid standing beside bushes without vision, and retaliate after Teemo leaves a bush. Push the wave and pressure the turret when Teemo cannot stay in lane, and look for an opportunity to go in with your allied jungler.
Teemo.phase: Early on, Tryndamere's trades are weak without Fury, so collect CS while avoiding Teemo's poke. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, pressure turrets with a split push.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap in front of objectives and in narrow paths, and watch for traps along your route when retreating. In teamfights, get past the frontline and approach the ranged carry from the side or behind. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused fire. If R Undying Rage is ready, you can also push the side lane opposite an objective to draw the enemy out.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so do not use basic attacks during it; back off or use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash instead. Teemo E Toxic Shot keeps dealing damage after even one basic attack, so wait outside his range if you are not ready to engage. Also watch out for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in bushes where you have no vision and Teemo R Noxious Trap hidden along paths.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. However, Trundle R Subjugate reduces your armor and magic resist and deals damage based on your max health, so prioritizing distance while it’s active matters more than stacking resistances or health. If Trundle builds armor and your basic attacks start dealing little damage, finish one core item, then get armor penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards.
Trundle.combo: Build Fury, then use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce his attack damage before engaging with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and continuing with basic attacks. If Trundle turns to run, look to slow him with Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. Use Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape or Tryndamere Q Bloodlust to heal before it ends.
Trundle.escape: When Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and Trundle W Frozen Domain has ended, look for a chance to engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so engaging then can force him to use Flash. Check your Fury and escape route before engaging, and avoid narrow paths where the pillar can easily block your retreat.
Trundle.fight: Build Fury, then use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce Trundle’s attack damage and Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage. Don’t extend the trade right after being hit by Trundle Q Chomp or while standing on Trundle W Frozen Domain; fight again after the effect ends. If you used Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, land critical strikes with basic attacks to create a chance to use it to disengage.
Trundle.laning: Early on, don’t trade with an empty Fury bar. Build Fury by hitting minions, then look for an opening. Trundle P King's Tribute heals him whenever a unit dies, so don’t let the lane drag on while chipping away at his health. After dealing damage, secure an advantage right away or shove the wave to force him to recall. Check river vision before going deep with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash.
Trundle.phase: Early on, Trundle’s basic attacks are strong and Tryndamere trades poorly without Fury, so manage the lane while building Fury.
Trundle.teamfight: In teamfights, flank or go around behind the frontline to target the ranged damage dealers. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline. When focused and about to die, activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage and take out the damage dealers while it lasts.
Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces your attack damage, putting you at a disadvantage in the trade right afterward. Don’t fight inside Trundle W Frozen Domain; back out and re-engage after it ends. When Trundle E Pillar of Ice appears, move to the side before its slow catches you. Keep your distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr's basic attack-focused damage. However, armor cannot block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. If Udyr builds armor and your basic attacks stop dealing much damage, complete one core item, then get armor penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards.
Udyr.combo: Build Fury, then use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce Udyr's attack damage, and close in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down. Follow up with basic attacks to build Fury, and look for the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout when Udyr turns to run. Cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it ends.
Udyr.escape: After you have endured a stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede once, or right after Udyr uses that dash, you have an opening to close the gap with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Udyr is fast, so it is difficult to escape by walking; save Tryndamere E Spinning Slash if you need to break off the chase. Immobilizing effects do not work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, so do not rely on them then.
Udyr.fight: Build Fury, then fight using Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce Udyr's attack damage. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, pressure him with basic attacks so he has no time to heal. If you have already endured one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, retaliate while he cannot immediately stun the same target again.
Udyr.laning: Do not move forward when Udyr is out of sight; use vision at key paths and jungle entrances to track his route. Build Fury and hold the lane, and clear the wave to pressure the turret during stretches when Udyr cannot stay in lane. Check river vision before using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage.
Udyr.phase: Early on, Tryndamere's trades are weak without Fury because he has no critical strike chance, so build Fury before fighting. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, pressure turrets by playing on the side lane.
Udyr.teamfight: Instead of focusing Udyr first while he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle, flank to target a vulnerable ranged carry. Engage after the enemy's immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline, and cast Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die under focused fire. When split pushing is more valuable than a teamfight, push the side opposite an objective, but do not go too deep while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is down.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes the gap and stuns, so watch your distance right after he activates a stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so do not rely on your health alone to withstand them.

Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Volibear P The Relentless Storm and E Sky Splitter deal magic damage, so armor alone won’t block all of it. If Volibear builds armor and your basic attacks stop dealing much damage, finish one core item, then buy Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards earlier than usual.
Volibear.combo: Build Fury, then use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce Volibear’s attack damage and engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, continuing with basic attacks. When Volibear turns to run, use W’s slow and land critical strikes to reduce E’s cooldown and create an escape route. If you activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before dying, use E to escape or Tryndamere Q Bloodlust to heal before it ends.
Volibear.escape: The stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash being down and Volibear R Stormbringer not being available yet create a chance to close the distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If only Q is down, he can still escape with R, so don’t rush your engage. When Volibear activates Q and chases you, use E or terrain to create distance instead of running straight away.
Volibear.fight: Build Fury to secure critical strike chance, then look to fight when Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks have expired. First use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce Volibear’s attack damage, then engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and continue with basic attacks. Volibear can heal with W Frenzied Maul after his health has decreased, so if you can’t finish him, back off and let cooldown time pass.
Volibear.laning: Before a fight, build Fury by hitting minions or using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash through the wave. After using E to engage, you may not have an immediate way out, so check river vision before going in. Prioritize holding the lane over forcing a kill, and push the wave to pressure the turret when Volibear can’t stay in lane.
Volibear.phase: Early on, Tryndamere trades poorly with no Fury, so avoid fighting while Volibear P The Relentless Storm has stacks. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, push a side lane to draw opponents away.
Volibear.teamfight: While Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under the turret at low health; use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to escape even from the leap’s landing area. In teamfights, flank or go around behind the frontline to target ranged damage dealers instead of fighting Volibear and the other frontline champions for too long. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline, and activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage when focused and about to die.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed to close in and stuns with an empowered basic attack, so stay outside his basic attack range and let time pass. When Volibear E Sky Splitter’s marker appears, walk to the side to avoid its damage and slow, and watch whether Volibear is trying to gain a shield inside it. If Volibear W Frenzied Maul marks you, stop trading unless you can finish him for certain; don’t give him a chance to empower the follow-up and heal.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Attack speed reduction also helps slow Yasuo’s basic attacks and tornado cycle.
Yasuo.combo: Build Fury with basic attacks as you fight. When Yasuo turns to run, use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to slow him. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it ends.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he has no way to knock you up for a while, creating an opportunity to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t chase just because he used it once; use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to close the distance when Yasuo R Last Breath is also down. Before engaging, check river vision and your Fury, and plan your escape route.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield by dealing damage once, then trade seriously after its short duration ends. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, with Fury already built, use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce his attack damage and engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, avoid forcing trades with no Fury and hit minions to build critical strike chance. Keeping a thin wave on your side of the lane limits Yasuo’s opportunities to approach by using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on minions. When your opponent can’t stay in lane, clear the wave and pressure the turret.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, Tryndamere trades poorly without Fury, so build Fury while holding the lane. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, focus on pushing a side lane to draw opponents away.
Yasuo.teamfight: In teamfights, flank or go around behind the frontline to target ranged damage dealers. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline, and use Tryndamere R Undying Rage when focused and about to die. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available and side lane pressure is valuable, you can also push the lane opposite the objective.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with its next attack after hitting twice in a row, so when its stacks are full, watch the effect and dodge sideways out of its line. Yasuo can follow the knockup with Yasuo R Last Breath, so be ready to use Tryndamere R Undying Rage if your health is in danger.

Yone.build: Prioritize critical strike items, since more critical strike chance increases Tryndamere’s basic attack damage and chances to use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash again. Yone’s damage is split between physical and magic, so if you build resistances, don’t focus on only one type. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your max health, so avoid relying on stacking health.
Yone.combo: Check your Battle Fury, then use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce Yone’s attack damage and engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Follow with basic attacks to build Battle Fury and land critical strikes to reduce Tryndamere E Spinning Slash’s cooldown. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it ends.
Yone.escape: When Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado stacks have expired and Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed are down, look for a chance to engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If only one of Yone’s movement abilities is down, he can escape with the other, so don’t rush your engage. Check Battle Fury first, especially if Tryndamere P Battle Fury is low, because you may struggle to use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash again after engaging.
Yone.fight: First use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce Yone’s attack damage, then engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and continue with basic attacks. When Yone turns to run, Tryndamere W Mocking Shout can also slow him.
Yone.laning: Build Battle Fury by hitting minions or using Tryndamere E Spinning Slash through the wave, then apply pressure. Keep your distance when Yone prepares his tornado with Q, and build an advantage with CS and turret pressure while he can’t stay in lane.
Yone.phase: If your team lacks teamfight damage later, pressure the lane and turret from a side lane, but don’t push deep while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is down.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit multiple people and grant him a larger shield, and don’t stand alone at the back of Yone R Fate Sealed’s path. Engage after Yone’s knockup has been used on your frontline, flanking or going around behind to target the enemy ranged damage dealers. When focused and about to die, activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage and secure an escape route with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash before it ends.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado becomes ready, so stay out of range until the stacks expire. After Yone E Soul Unbound engages, he can deal additional damage on his return, so if your health is low, heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust or create distance with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so don’t stand in its entry path with your team during a teamfight.

Yorick.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on your max health, so avoid relying on stacking health. If Yorick builds armor and your basic attacks stop dealing much damage, finish one core item, then get armor penetration with Last Whisper or Lord Dominik's Regards.
Yorick.combo: With Fury built, use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce Yorick’s attack damage, then engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash and continue with basic attacks. If Yorick turns to run and Tryndamere W Mocking Shout is available, look to slow him. Activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage just before you die, then escape with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash or heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust before it ends.
Yorick.escape: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist and when Yorick W Dark Procession is down, look for a chance to engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall or cross it with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. If you need to use Tryndamere R Undying Rage, plan your escape route first.
Yorick.fight: Avoid fighting when Yorick has many graves nearby or Mist Walkers are close at hand; clear the Mist Walkers before fighting. Right after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, if you have enough Fury, use Tryndamere W Mocking Shout to reduce his attack damage and engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Unless you’re in immediate danger of dying, don’t heal the damage from Yorick Q Last Rites right away with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust; preserve your damage output.
Yorick.laning: Build Fury by hitting minions before fighting, then step forward to farm after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist. Push the lane so Yorick can’t build graves while clearing the wave on his side, and pressure the turret when he can’t stay in lane. Check river vision before engaging with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash.
Yorick.phase: Early on, Tryndamere trades poorly when his Fury is empty, so build Fury and dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist while managing the lane. If your team lacks teamfight damage later, push a side lane while responding to Yorick’s pressure.
Yorick.teamfight: If you join a teamfight, flank or go around behind the frontline to target ranged damage dealers instead of fighting the frontline for too long. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing crowd control has been used on your frontline, and activate Tryndamere R Undying Rage when focused and about to die. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available, you can also push the opposite side lane from the objective to draw opponents away.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, deals damage based on your max health, and marks you, so watch its projectile and dodge it. If trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall to break it or cross it with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. When the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking, create distance from Yorick himself.
